notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetching collects title and description, but not the target favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: Editing supports title, description, tags, and collection, but the URL is locked and notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose the required text and tags, but use generated initials rather than actual favicons.
REF-BM-10: Tag fields are plain text inputs with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, and tags, but not notes or the full URL.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and therefore does not match ordinary stored tag names.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection mechanism or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the entire current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF-download preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: The archive control is nonfunctional and bookmarks have no archived state.
REF-BM-27: Deletion exists, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: The archive control does not open or filter an archived-bookmark list.
REF-BM-29: Collections are static categories, not reusable saved search/tag bundles with exclusions.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import preserves titles and tags but ignores ADD_DATE and substitutes an Imported label.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is nonfunctional and no personal display settings are stored.
